sentences.en: Don't make any noise or you'll scare the birds away.
sentences.zh: 别发出声音，否则会把鸟儿吓走。

sentences.en: Hiromi decided to risk bungee-jumping, even though he was scared.
sentences.zh: hiroumi决定冒险尝试蹦极，尽管他感到害怕。

sentences.en: She became scared when she noticed the man following her.
sentences.zh: 她注意到有个男人跟着自己后变得很害怕。
